v.t: By the Mount
v.l: Wa At-Turi

v.t: And a Book inscribed
v.l: Wa Kitabin Masturin

v.t: In a published scroll
v.l: Fi Raqqin Manshurin

v.t: And the frequented House
v.l: Wa Al-Bayti Al-Ma`muri

v.t: And the elevated roof
v.l: Wa As-Saqfi Al-Marfu`i

v.t: And the seething sea
v.l: Wa Al-Bahri Al-Masjuri

v.t: The punishment of your Lord is coming
v.l: Inna `Adhaba Rabbika Lawaqi`un

v.t: There is nothing to avert it
v.l: Ma Lahu Min Dafi`in

v.t: On the Day when the heaven sways in agitation
v.l: Yawma Tamuru As-Sama'u Mawraan

v.t: And the mountains go into motion
v.l: Wa Tasiru Al-Jibalu Sayraan

v.t: Woe on that Day to the deniers
v.l: Fawaylun Yawma'idhin Lilmukadhibina

v.t: Those who play with speculation
v.l: Al-Ladhina Hum Fi Khawđin Yal`abuna

v.t: The Day when they are shoved into the Fire of Hell forcefully
v.l: Yawma Yuda``una 'Ila Nari Jahannama Da``aan

v.t: “This is the Fire which you used to deny
v.l: Hadhihi An-Naru Allati Kuntum Biha Tukadhibuna

v.t: Is this magic, or do you not see
v.l: Afasihrun Hadha 'Am 'Antum La Tubsiruna

v.t: Burn in it. Whether you are patient, or impatient, it is the same for you. You are only being repaid for what you used to do.”
v.l: Aslawha Fasbiru 'Aw La Tasbiru Sawa'un `Alaykum 'Innama Tujzawna Ma Kuntum Ta`maluna

v.t: But the righteous will be amid gardens and bliss
v.l: Inna Al-Muttaqina Fi Jannatin Wa Na`imin

v.t: Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord has spared them the suffering of Hell
v.l: Fakihina Bima 'Atahum Rabbuhum Wa Waqahum Rabbuhum `Adhaba Al-Jahimi

v.t: Eat and drink happily, for what you used to do
v.l: Kulu Wa Ashrabu Hani'aan Bima Kuntum Ta`maluna

v.t: Relaxing on luxurious furnishings; and We will couple them with gorgeous spouses
v.l: Muttaki'ina `Ala Sururin Masfufatin Wa Zawwajnahum Bihurin `Inin

v.t: Those who believed and their offspring followed them in faith—We will unite them with their offspring, and We will not deprive them of any of their works. Every person is hostage to what he has earned
v.l: Wa Al-Ladhina 'Amanu Wa Attaba`at/hum Dhurriyatuhum Bi'imanin 'Alhaqna Bihim Dhurriyatahum Wa Ma 'Alatnahum Min `Amalihim Min Shay'in Kullu Amri'in Bima Kasaba Rahinun

v.t: And We will supply them with fruit, and meat; such as they desire
v.l: Wa 'Amdadnahum Bifakihatin Wa Lahmin Mimma Yashtahuna

v.t: They will exchange therein a cup; wherein is neither harm, nor sin
v.l: Yatanaza`una Fiha Ka'saan La Laghwun Fiha Wa La Ta'thimun
w: They will pass to one another

v.t: Serving them will be youths like hidden pearls
v.l: Wa Yatufu `Alayhim Ghilmanun Lahum Ka'annahum Lu'ulu'uun Maknunun

v.t: And they will approach one another, inquiring
v.l: Wa 'Aqbala Ba`đuhum `Ala Ba`đin Yatasa'aluna

v.t: They will say, “Before this, we were fearful for our families
v.l: Qalu 'Inna Kunna Qablu Fi 'Ahlina Mushfiqina

v.t: But God blessed us, and spared us the agony of the Fiery Winds
v.l: Famanna Allahu `Alayna Wa Waqana `Adhaba As-Samumi

v.t: Before this, we used to pray to Him. He is the Good, the Compassionate.”
v.l: Inna Kunna Min Qablu Nad`uhu 'Innahu Huwa Al-Barru Ar-Rahimu

v.t: So remind. By the grace of your Lord, you are neither a soothsayer, nor a madman
v.l: Fadhakkir Fama 'Anta Bini`mati Rabbika Bikahinin Wa La Majnunin

v.t: Or do they say, “A poet—we await for him a calamity of time”
v.l: Am Yaquluna Sha`irun Natarabbasu Bihi Rayba Al-Manuni

v.t: Say, “Go on waiting; I will be waiting with you.”
v.l: Qul Tarabbasu Fa'inni Ma`akum Mina Al-Mutarabbisina

v.t: Or is it that their dreams compel them to this? Or are they aggressive people
v.l: Am Ta'muruhum 'Ahlamuhum Bihadha 'Am Hum Qawmun Taghuna

v.t: Or do they say, “He made it up”? Rather, they do not believe
v.l: Am Yaquluna Taqawwalahu Bal La Yu'uminuna

v.t: So let them produce a discourse like it, if they are truthful
v.l: Falya'tu Bihadithin Mithlihi 'In Kanu Sadiqina

v.t: Or were they created out of nothing? Or are they the creators
v.l: Am Khuliqu Min Ghayri Shay'in 'Am Humu Al-Khaliquna

v.t: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? In fact, they are not certain
v.l: Am Khalaqu As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđa Bal La Yuqinuna

v.t: Or do they possess the treasuries of your Lord? Or are they the controllers
v.l: Am `Indahum Khaza'inu Rabbika 'Am Humu Al-Musaytiruna

v.t: Or do they have a stairway by means of which they listen? Then let their listener produce a clear proof
v.l: Am Lahum Sullamun Yastami`una Fihi Falya'ti Mustami`uhum Bisultanin Mubinin

v.t: Or for Him the daughters, and for you the sons
v.l: Am Lahu Al-Banatu Wa Lakumu Al-Banuna

v.t: Or do you demand a payment from them, and they are burdened by debt
v.l: Am Tas'aluhum 'Ajraan Fahum Min Maghramin Muthqaluna

v.t: Or do they know the future, and they are writing it down
v.l: Am `Indahumu Al-Ghaybu Fahum Yaktubuna

v.t: Or are they planning a conspiracy? The conspiracy will befall the disbelievers
v.l: Am Yuriduna Kaydaan Fa-Al-Ladhina Kafaru Humu Al-Makiduna

v.t: Or do they have a god besides God? God transcends what they associate
v.l: Am Lahum 'Ilahun Ghayru Allahi Subhana Allahi `Amma Yushrikuna

v.t: Even if they were to see lumps of the sky falling down, they would say, “A mass of clouds.”
v.l: Wa 'In Yaraw Kisfaan Mina As-Sama'i Saqitaan Yaqulu Sahabun Markumun

v.t: So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be stunned
v.l: Fadharhum Hatta Yulaqu Yawmahumu Al-Ladhi Fihi Yus`aquna

v.t: The Day when their ploys will avail them nothing; and they will not be helped
v.l: Yawma La Yughni `Anhum Kayduhum Shay'aan Wa La Hum Yunsaruna

v.t: For those who do wrong, there is a punishment besides that; but most of them do not know
v.l: Wa 'Inna Lilladhina Zalamu `Adhabaan Duna Dhalika Wa Lakinna 'Aktharahum La Ya`lamuna

v.t: So patiently await the decision of your Lord, for you are before Our Eyes; and proclaim the praises of your Lord when you arise
v.l: Wa Asbir Lihukmi Rabbika Fa'innaka Bi'a`yunina Wa Sabbih Bihamdi Rabbika Hina Taqumu

v.t: And glorify Him during the night, and at the receding of the stars
v.l: Wa Mina Al-Layli Fasabbihhu Wa 'Idbara An-Nujumi
